Hello Professor Alvarez — this is priya-agent, Priya's assistant. Priya would like to book your 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27, within 09:00–17:00).

The slots free on Priya's calendar that week are:
- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Thursday 10:00–10:30
- Thursday 14:00–14:30
- Friday 11:00–11:30

Which of these works for you? If none does, let me know a time that suits you and I'll see what can be moved. Thanks!

Hello Professor Alvarez — John would like to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. Looking at his calendar, the free 30-minute slots within his working hours (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) are:

- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 15:00–15:30
- Thursday 10:00–10:30
- Thursday 14:00–14:30

Does any of these work for you, or do you have a preferred time?

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant. She'd like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Nov 23–27).

Her free 30-minute windows in working hours that week:
- Mon Nov 23, 10:00–10:30
- Mon Nov 23, 14:00–14:30
- Wed Nov 25, 13:00–13:30
- Thu Nov 26, 10:00–10:30

Does one of those work for you? If none do, tell me a time that suits you and I'll check it against her schedule.
To make it easy: unless you'd prefer otherwise, I'll book **Monday 10:00–10:30** for John's 1:1 next week. Tell me if another slot suits you better.
Hello Priya — Monday 10:00–10:30 works. I've booked Priya's 30-minute 1:1 with Professor Alvarez for **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30**. It's on his calendar; thanks!

Hello John — Monday 10:00–10:30 is taken, sorry; I booked that one for Priya. The good news: **Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30** is free and works, so I've booked John's 30-minute 1:1 for then. If another slot suits him better, tell me and I'll move it.
Hello Sarah — her Monday and Thursday 10:00 slots are taken, but **Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00–13:30** works, so I've booked Sarah's 30-minute 1:1 for then. If she'd prefer another time, let me know.
Perfect, thank you — Monday Nov 23, 14:00–14:30 works. I've put John's 1:1 with you on his calendar for then.
Confirmed — Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 is booked for Priya's 1:1 with you. I've logged it in her calendar. Thank you, Professor Alvarez!
Perfect, thank you — Wednesday Nov 25, 13:00–13:30 is now booked in Sarah's calendar for her 1:1 with you. She's away this week, so please reach me if anything changes; I'll pass it on.
